title: Anthropic says voice mode for Claude Code is now live for about 5% of users, with a broader rollout planned in the coming weeks (Lauren Forristal/TechCrunch)
summary: Lauren Forristal / TechCrunch: Anthropic says voice mode for Claude Code is now live for about 5% of users, with a broader rollout planned in the coming weeks — Anthropic is bringing Voice Mode to Claude Code, the company's AI coding assistant for developers. The launch of voice mode marks a significant step toward more hands-free …
